content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for MGU Recruitment 2026 is Grounds Man cum Marker. This walk-in drive is for a specific role within the university's maintenance department, offering a contract-based government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MGU Grounds Man cum Marker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Grounds Man cum Marker post in the Mahatma Gandhi University Recruitment 2026. This is a single opening for a dedicated and experienced individual.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker posts is "Walk-in". Interested candidates need to attend a direct interview on the specified date and venue with their documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker is 08 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they arrive on time with all necessary documents for registration and interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker posts must be a minimum of 20 years old and a maximum of 56 years old. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Grounds Man cum Marker?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an FDSC or equivalent qualification. Additionally, 5 years of experience in grounds maintenance and 2 years of experience using a lawn mower are required for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Grounds Man cum Marker at MGU?
faq.answer: The salary for Grounds Man cum Marker at MGU is Rs. 645 per day, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 20,000. This is a contract-based remuneration structure.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker recruitment for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. Applicants can attend the walk-in free of charge.

faq.answer: The selection process for MGU Grounds Man cum Marker involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in the interview and the authenticity of their submitted documents.
